observational_model_exact_set_reproducti.target: have/keep your beady eye(s) on somebody/something
be sick of/can't stand/hate the sight of somebody/something
run/stretch/walk etc the (full) length of something

local_source_audit.scope: Four families reproduced exactly; does not establish that all upstream rules have been recovered.

improvements: Treat multiword choices as groups rather than independent slash-bearing tokens.
Match etc only as a complete marker word, preserving words such as stretch.
Use LDOCE6 part-of-speech and source-example evidence; retain uncertain notation for review.
Move generic objects only when the original LDOCE6 separability marker permits it; preserve following prepositional complements.
Allow bounded query shorthand for initial be and generic objects; retain lexical your and sentence/infinitive subjects.
Normalize source punctuation/hyphens and explicit comma-order names.
Do not automatically add past, progressive or plural forms, or invent lexical synonyms.
runtime_input: Only LDOCE6 extraction.sqlite. LDOCE5++ is used exclusively for offline comparison and rule research.
improvements_scope: The improvements list above describes the r3 baseline; r4 additions below supersede its no-inflection and lexical-your policies.
r4_additions: Supplement explicit source head variants, compound keys, grammatical classes and declared inflections after excluding foreign popup entries.
Expand finite object, possessive and reflexive slots, including generic your; keep arbitrary names and noun phrases out of generated aliases.
Add first-verb inflections and countable noun plurals constrained by complete head and sense homograph evidence; source forms override regular fallback.
Resolve independent separable object/particle choices and repeated-head whole phrase alternatives; retain uncertain notation for review.
Keep lowercased lookup aliases for source-capitalized spellings. Every generated alias resolves directly to existing source content.
Validate native full-input hits against the actual source canonical target; mark absent source patterns separately from engine failures.
active_policy: Historical r3/r4 rule lists below are superseded by this policy.
No generated pronoun, possessive or reflexive substitutions; no automatic verb/noun inflections.
No unmarked deletion of objects, possessives or initial be; retain explicit optional brackets.
No synthesized hyphen-to-space spellings; preserve declared source spelling variants.
No comma-list or slash-list guessing for declared forms; record ambiguous source forms for review.
No POS-only acceptance of slash candidates or guessed inversion of capitalized names.
Retain bounded explicit notation, full alternatives, source-example-attested choices, marked separability, trailing-article indexing and lowercase lookup.
Report unhandled input patterns together for engine work rather than enumerate surface spellings.
